concepts.definition: A named isolation boundary for source, indexes, reviews, and queries.
excludes: A Git checkout
one dataset version

concepts.definition: One immutable coordinated build of graph, vector, and optional semantic projections.
excludes: The mutable active pointer
source repository

concepts.definition: A captured and identified set of source bytes and policies to which all evidence in a dataset refers.
excludes: A Git commit alone when working-tree bytes differ
an uncaptured editor buffer

concepts.definition: A source document or code file addressed relative to one source snapshot.
excludes: Historical hunk path counted as a current file

concepts.definition: A language parser's named code construct with a source range and stable join identity.
excludes: A vector chunk without a verified AST anchor

concepts.definition: A bounded source span represented by an embedding and searchable metadata.
excludes: A semantic fact proven only by similarity

concepts.definition: A heading-scoped span of a source document with exact source lines.
excludes: A fabricated summary without source lines

concepts.definition: A reviewable statement about the project that cites a source section.
excludes: A heading alone
ungrounded model output

concepts.definition: An origin, relative path, line range, file digest, and range digest tied to one source snapshot.
excludes: A similarity score without retrievable source

concepts.definition: A typed and directed relationship between two identified objects with separate evidence and review state.
excludes: An untyped graph edge treated as proven meaning

concepts.definition: A stable domain meaning with a definition, scope, aliases, and review status.
excludes: One query token
an AST node type

concepts.definition: A language-specific preferred or alternative expression for a concept.
excludes: The concept's complete definition

concepts.definition: A versioned statement of intended system behavior independent of implementation.
excludes: A claim that current code already satisfies it

concepts.definition: A checkable condition for accepting one requirement at a named snapshot.
excludes: A test result without its execution context

concepts.definition: A repeatable input and expected observation used to verify behavior.
excludes: A successful result from an unspecified run

concepts.definition: An execution of tests with recorded command, environment, source snapshot, and outcome.
excludes: A test file that has never been run

concepts.definition: A versioned constraint controlling indexing, access, review, or evidence release.
excludes: A retrieved passage that merely mentions a rule

concepts.definition: A bounded and sanitized CKS response containing citations, bodies, graph neighbors, and integrity metadata.
excludes: Unreviewed semantic assertion treated as verified

concepts.definition: An immutable attempt to apply a change from one base snapshot, producing a result snapshot and check evidence.
excludes: An unexecuted change plan
promotion of the active dataset

concepts.definition: A human decision with reasons and evidence about one acceptance criterion at a named specification version and result snapshot.
excludes: A passing test alone
existence of a test link

concepts.definition: Metadata-constrained nearest-chunk retrieval that reports bounded-search incompleteness.
includes: Eligible nearest chunks, exact-sized sparse candidate ordering, cancellation and search budget status
excludes: Versioned policy authority, source capture, semantic truth

concepts.definition: Validation of semantic relation evidence against one captured source identity and coordinated graph/vector indexes.
includes: Typed proof references, source snapshot alignment, rejection before storing or switching a candidate
excludes: Full capture lifecycle implementation, human approval of relation meaning, automatic criterion acceptance

concepts.definition: Optional interpretation of concepts that preserves the baseline retrieval citation set for ambiguous or unreviewed meanings.
includes: Natural-language matching, no unreviewed relation boost, optional fallback
excludes: Whole term storage implementation, whole evidence response construction, live retrieval quality proof

requirements.title: Filtered CKV recall
requirements.statement: CKV returns eligible nearest chunks under sparse metadata filters.

acceptance_criteria.given: A sparse filter leaves an exact-search-sized candidate set with at least K eligible chunks and many closer excluded chunks
acceptance_criteria.when: A filtered query requests K results
acceptance_criteria.then: The response contains K eligible chunks in exact distance order

acceptance_criteria.given: A larger filtered candidate set contains at least K eligible chunks
acceptance_criteria.when: A filtered query reaches a search budget or is cancelled
acceptance_criteria.then: The response marks incomplete with a reason and never claims K-result completeness

requirements.title: Source-backed meaning
requirements.statement: Reviewed semantic relationships remain tied to one captured source snapshot.

acceptance_criteria.given: A relation with a code anchor from another snapshot
acceptance_criteria.then: Promotion fails and the active dataset remains unchanged

requirements.title: Safe ontology interpretation
requirements.statement: Optional concept matching preserves the existing hybrid retrieval candidates.

acceptance_criteria.given: An ambiguous term or an unverified concept relationship
acceptance_criteria.when: A user asks a natural-language question
acceptance_criteria.then: The baseline CKV and CKG citation set is preserved

claims.statement: Pinned v2 유지보수는 제자리 갱신과 legacy downgrade를 거부하고 검토 설정·project ID와 새 버전으로 후보를 만든다.
후보 checkpoint/sync 뒤 current를 전환하고 부모를 sync한다. rename 후 sync 실패의 durability_uncertain은 current 불변을 뜻하지 않는다.
v2 core evidence는32000bytes/12citation 안에서 검증된 전체 원문 span을 선택하고 생략을 partial/예산 진단으로 기록하며 긴 span을 잘라 반환하지 않는다.
Worksheet의 조직 위험 목록은 명시적으로 선택한 local pack 자료에만 들어 있다. 생성은 앵커 검사를 실행하거나 항목을 verified로 승격하지 않는다.
Git 소스는 기준HEAD/선택 복구 객체를 해시된 history.bundle로 봉인하고 독립 저장소로 복원해 빌드하여 원본의 이후 이력 변화와 분리한다.
신규 executable-bit-v1 입력은 파일 실행 비트도 identity에 포함하며 snapshot v5와 구 v2–v4 읽기를 구분해 과거 바이트·신원을 재해석하지 않는다.
